relations.support_notes: [S635TW6P]: 80 suggests that the author could be Bru sha bSod nams seng ge (ID:3841), 'U yug pa bSod nams seng ge (ID:3846), or Lo tsA ba bsod nams seng ge.

comments:
In the conclusive verses, the author declares his agreement with Candrakīrti's (ID:3725) explanations, and claims to have followed the instruction of his bla ma.

The work has 27 chapters (like the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā (ID:3715)) and no nested hierarchical structure (sa bcad).
